name: code-control
description: A source control pane for Claude Code: changes, branches, stash, history and conflicts of every git repository in the session.

fetchIntervalMinutes.title: Fetch interval (minutes)
fetchIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between automatic fetches (at least 1): all session long while the row above the prompt shows, otherwise while the pane is open. 0 turns off all automatic fetching, the fetch when the pane opens included.

language.title: Language
language.description: Pane language: auto, en or pt-BR.

showStatusRow.title: Row above the prompt
showStatusRow.description: Show the selected repository, its branch and its state in a row above the prompt; pressing it opens the pane. Off, the repositories are read only while the pane is open.

commitMessageModel.title: Commit message model
commitMessageModel.description: Model alias or id the ✦ button uses.
